plans.name: effect-diagnostics-baseline-guard
plans.overview: Establish the enforced no-suppression contract for Effect diagnostics, preserve a reproducible diagnostic inventory, and prevent new `@effect-diagnostics` comments from entering the codebase while cleanup proceeds.

todos.content: Re-run the unsuppressed main and test checker experiment and record the current file by category inventory for the cleanup branch.
Add a repository check that fails when any source file contains `@effect-diagnostics` and wire it into the existing quality gate.
Decide and encode whether `tests/tsconfig.json` is an enforced gate for this cleanup, including handling existing test-only checker failures.
Record that stale token-only cleanup is superseded by the suppression-ban gate; later cleanup lanes must delete whole comments instead of narrowing categories.

plans.name: effect-strict-boolean-cleanup
plans.overview: Remove the dominant `strictBooleanExpressions` diagnostics by replacing truthy and falsy control flow with explicit null, undefined, length, and boolean checks across shared workflow, API handlers, server modules, and the workflow UI.

todos.content: Replace non-boolean conditions in `shared/coursition/workflow.ts` with explicit predicates while preserving gate and finding behavior.
Replace non-boolean conditions in `api/effect/index.ts` with explicit session, user, cookie, and name checks.
Replace non-boolean conditions in `server/coursition/store.ts` and `server/coursition/ai-provider.ts` without changing generated course behavior.
Replace non-boolean conditions in `src/features/coursition/coursition-workflow-app.tsx` with explicit checks while preserving React render state and navigation behavior.
Run an unsuppressed checker pass and confirm no `strictBooleanExpressions` diagnostics remain in the selected cleanup files.

plans.name: effect-config-platform-boundary
plans.overview: Replace raw environment and platform-boundary reads with an accepted Effect-compatible configuration layer, including the dependency decision needed for `Config`, Node runtime services, and Modern config compatibility.

todos.content: Decide whether to use Modern BFF Effect re-exports only or add explicit `effect` and platform dependencies for config, filesystem, HTTP, time, and random services.
Add typed Coursition configuration accessors for AI provider, source providers, auth defaults, telemetry, and site URL values.
Replace direct env reads in `modern.config.ts` and `server/coursition/auth.ts` with the accepted config boundary without weakening production site URL validation.
Replace direct env reads in `server/coursition/store.ts` and `server/coursition/ai-provider.ts` with typed config access while preserving local fallback behavior.
Add focused coverage for development, test, production, local fallback, and missing provider configuration paths.

plans.name: effect-server-io-runtime
plans.overview: Move server-side filesystem, HTTP, time, random, sleep, and async workflow operations into Effect runtime boundaries while preserving the Promise-shaped APIs expected by Modern BFF, route loaders, and tests.

todos.content: Add a server runtime boundary that can run Coursition Effect programs from Modern handlers, route loaders, and test helpers.
Replace JSON-store filesystem operations, timestamps, temporary IDs, and mutation queue operations in `server/coursition/store.ts` with Effect services.
Replace provider fetch calls, retry waits, local fallback deadlines, and timestamp creation in `server/coursition/ai-provider.ts` with Effect programs.
Replace route loader session fetch and async loader helpers in `src/routes/[lang]/course-page-loader.ts` with the accepted Effect boundary.
Keep BFF handler signatures working while replacing `Effect.tryPromise` wrappers around non-Effect internals with direct Effect composition.
Run unsuppressed checker passes and confirm server, API, auth, config, and loader files no longer need diagnostic comments.

plans.name: effect-ui-tests-cleanup
plans.overview: Finish diagnostic removal in the React workflow surface and tests, including raw browser fetch, async handlers, test harness Node usage, and the final deletion of every `@effect-diagnostics` comment.

todos.content: Replace raw workflow API fetch in `coursition-workflow-app.tsx` with the accepted client or Effect boundary while preserving error messages and credentials.
Refactor React async handlers and autosave chains so async control flow is represented through the chosen Effect boundary or isolated framework adapters.
Extract focused hooks or helper modules from `coursition-workflow-app.tsx` only where it makes diagnostic cleanup reviewable.
Remove test-file suppressions by replacing raw Node env and process usage or by adding explicit test adapters that satisfy the selected checker scope.
Remove every remaining `@effect-diagnostics` comment from the repository and confirm the suppression ban passes.
Run format, lint, typecheck, i18n check, tests, skills check, and ultramodern contract validation after all suppressions are gone.
